mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document ( document_type, title, content, employee_id, approval_type, status, is_urgent ) VALUES ( #{documentType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{employeeId}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, #{isUrgent} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY doc_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET title = #{title} , content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW(), is_urgent =#{isUrgent} WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'DRAFT'

INSERT INTO approval_line (doc_id, approver_id, approval_order, approval_type, approval_status) VALUES
(#{line.docId}, #{line.approverId}, #{line.approvalOrder}, #{line.approvalType}, #{line.approvalStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, d.document_type, d.status, d.is_urgent, d.employee_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, de.name AS drafter_name, de.position AS drafter_position, dt.team_name AS drafter_team, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name FROM document d JOIN employee de ON d.employee_id = de.employee_id LEFT JOIN team dt ON de.team_id = dt.team_id JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE d.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND d.status != 'DRAFT' ORDER BY d.doc_id DESC, al.approval_order

SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, d.document_type, d.status, d.is_urgent, d.employee_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, de.name AS drafter_name, de.position AS drafter_position, dt.team_name AS drafter_team, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name FROM document d JOIN employee de ON d.employee_id = de.employee_id LEFT JOIN team dt ON de.team_id = dt.team_id JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT al2.doc_id FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line prev WHERE prev.doc_id = al2.doc_id AND prev.approval_order < al2.approval_order AND prev.approval_status != 'APPROVED')) ORDER BY d.doc_id DESC, al.approval_order

SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, d.document_type, d.status, d.is_urgent, d.employee_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, de.name AS drafter_name, de.position AS drafter_position, dt.team_name AS drafter_team, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name FROM document d JOIN employee de ON d.employee_id = de.employee_id LEFT JOIN team dt ON de.team_id = dt.team_id JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM approval_line WHERE approver_id = #{employeeId} AND approval_status != 'PENDING') ORDER BY d.doc_id DESC, al.approval_order

SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, d.document_type, d.status, d.is_urgent, d.employee_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, de.name AS drafter_name, de.position AS drafter_position, dt.team_name AS drafter_team, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name,d.content, al.comment, al.approved_at, vr.vacation_id, vr.vacation_type_id, vr.start_date, vr.end_date, vr.days, vr.reason, vr.start_half, vr.end_half, vt.type_name,vt.deduct_balance FROM document d JOIN employee de ON d.employee_id = de.employee_id LEFT JOIN team dt ON de.team_id = dt.team_id JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN vacation_request vr ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id LEFT JOIN vacation_type vt ON vr.vacation_type_id = vt.vacation_type_id WHERE d.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY al.approval_order
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, comment = #{comment}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approver_id = #{approverId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vacation_request ( doc_id, employee_id, vacation_type_id,start_date ,end_date,start_half ,end_half, days,reason ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{employeeId}, #{vacationTypeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{startHalf}, #{endHalf}, #{days}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'APPROVED' THEN vr.days ELSE 0 END) AS usedDays, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'PENDING' THEN vr.days ELSE 0 END) AS pendingDays FROM vacation_request vr JOIN document d ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id JOIN vacation_type vt ON vt.vacation_type_id = vr.vacation_type_id WHERE vr.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND vt.deduct_balance = 1

SELECT vr.*, vt.type_name, d.status, DATE_FORMAT(vr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at FROM vacation_request vr JOIN document d ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id JOIN vacation_type vt ON vt.vacation_type_id = vr.vacation_type_id WHERE vr.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY vr.vacation_id DESC
